name: atr_expansion_breakout_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: When the current bar's True Range exceeds 2.5x the ATR(20), it signals a volatility regime change — the market has shifted from a low-energy state to a high-energy state. If this expansion bar also breaks the session high/low and closes in the direction of the break, it represents a genuine volatility breakout with high follow-through probability. The edge exists because standard breakout strategies use price levels (support/resistance) as triggers, while this uses volatility expansion as the trigger. A bar that is 2.5x normal ATR represents an abnormal event — institutional order flow, news impact, or algorithmic momentum ignition. The inefficiency persists because comparing current bar TR to rolling ATR in real-time is simple in concept but rarely used as a primary entry trigger.
mechanism: ATR measures the amplitude of recent price swings. When current price movement exceeds the ATR envelope, it signals a breakout from the volatility regime. Such breakouts typically result from institutional flow entering the market, and the move persists until the flow is absorbed, usually within 1-3 ATR multiples of the breakout point.

conditions: high > session_high[t-1] (new session high on expansion bar)
(close - low) / (high - low) > 0.6 (closed in upper 40% of bar)
low < session_low[t-1] (new session low on expansion bar)
(high - close) / (high - low) > 0.6 (closed in lower 40% of bar)

exit.signal_exit: exit if next 3 bars all have TR < ATR_20 (volatility contraction, expansion over)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 28; in extreme VIX, expansion bars are common and less meaningful
filters.volume_filter: volume_ratio > 2.0 on expansion bar (must be volume-confirmed, not low-liquidity wide spread)

weaknesses: Large TR bars can be caused by a single fat finger or erroneous trade — the volume filter mitigates but does not eliminate this
The follow-through bar requirement adds a full minute of delay — in fast moves, the optimal entry is on the expansion bar itself
ATR_20 on 1-min bars = only 20 minutes of data; early-session ATR may be elevated from open, making 2.5x threshold harder to hit
prior_art: Volatility breakout is core to many systems: Keltner Channel expansion, Bollinger Band width, TTM Squeeze. Using TR/ATR ratio specifically is discussed by Van Tharp ('Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom') and Perry Kaufman ('Trading Systems and Methods'). The specific 2.5x threshold and session-high/low coincidence requirement adds selectivity beyond standard volatility breakout approaches.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
